questions.question_zh: 第73—74小节的主旋律中，演奏者对哪一个音使用了最明显的弹性节奏（rubato）处理？
questions.question_en: Which note of the main melody is played with the most rubato in bars 73-74?
questions.answer_instructions: 音名及八度，例如 C#4。

questions.question_zh: 聆听开头到第一次整体静默之前的第一个乐思。按先后顺序写出其加速／减速轮廓。
questions.question_en: The performer plays the first thought (the music fragment before the first global silence) with a lot of rubato. Describe the contour of the acceleration/deceleration: if the performer first slows down and then accelerates, write 'slower, faster'.
questions.answer_instructions: 用 faster、slower 表示阶段，以英文逗号分隔；保留先后顺序。

questions.question_zh: 从录音02:51开始的主题，在第几小节到达一种反常规的、安静的高潮？此处速度与音量均明显下降。
questions.question_en: Consider the theme starting at 2:51. In which bar does the performer reach the subverted, silent climax of this theme, characterized by a significant slow-down in tempo and loudness?
questions.answer_instructions: 单个小节号，只写整数。

questions.question_zh: 03:00稍后出现旋律 F, G, G, Eb, Eb, D, C, D, D, Bb。之后音乐继续转调：根据主要主题在新调中的再现，接下来转到什么调？
questions.question_en: When the piano plays the melody 'F, G, G, Eb, Eb, D, C, D, D, Bb' a little after 03:00, the piece continues to modulate. To which key is the music modulating next, as evidenced by the return of one of the primary themes in the new key?
questions.answer_instructions: 音级加 major 或 minor，例如 C major；解释可用中文。

questions.question_zh: 01:57—02:06之间，演奏者强调了一条由连续叹息音型构成的旋律。按出现顺序写出这条旋律，直到该声部出现 F#3。
questions.question_en: What are the notes of the melodic line consisting of a sequence of sighs emphasized by the performer between 01:57 and 02:06, up until the F#3 appears in that line?
questions.answer_instructions: 仅写音级，不写八度；用英文逗号分隔，保留重复音和先后顺序。

questions.question_zh: 03:37—03:43之间，演奏者突出的短小中声部由哪些具体音组成？
questions.question_en: Which specific notes form the short middle voice highlighted by the performer between 3:37 and 3:43?
questions.answer_instructions: 音名及八度组成的有序列表，以英文逗号分隔。

questions.question_zh: 录音02:56—02:57所对应的较长音符下方，谱面写着什么演奏指示？
questions.question_en: What performance instruction is written below the longer notes in 02:56-02:57?
questions.answer_instructions: 写完整的意大利语／英语音乐术语，不仅写缩写。

questions.question_zh: 第53小节的装饰音在这次实际演奏中从哪个音开始？
questions.question_en: With which pitch does the ornamentation in measure 53 start?
questions.answer_instructions: 音名及八度。

questions.question_zh: 第243小节中，右手有一个音在实际演奏里受到很强的强调，可能并非有意为之，并略微打断旋律的流动。是哪一个音？
questions.question_en: In measure 243, a particular note in the right hand gets a strong emphasis during the performance, perhaps accidentally, slightly breaking the flow of the melody. Which note?
questions.answer_instructions: 仅写音级，不写八度。

questions.question_zh: 如果严格保持第243小节的速度，最后一个和弦相对实际演奏将延后多少个八分音符的时值？结果向下取整。
questions.question_en: If the tempo of bar 243 were maintained strictly, by how many eighth-note durations would the final chord be delayed? Round down.
questions.answer_instructions: 非负整数，以八分音符时值为单位。

questions.question_zh: 第170—180小节之间，演奏者在哪两个小节减速最明显？
questions.question_en: In which 2 bars does the performer slow down most between bars 170 and 180?
questions.answer_instructions: 两个小节号，按出现顺序以英文逗号分隔。

questions.question_zh: 在呈示部中，第一次向本曲关系小调形成正格终止发生在什么时间？请给出该终止中导音被奏响的时刻。
questions.question_en: At what time during the exposition does an authentic cadence to the piece's relative minor tonality first occur? Provide the time of when the leading tone within that cadence is struck.
questions.answer_instructions: 录音绝对时间 MM:SS，向下取整到整秒。

questions.question_zh: 主主题以小调形式出现，是从录音的什么时间开始的？
questions.question_en: At what time does the main theme in a minor tonality start?
questions.answer_instructions: 录音绝对时间 MM:SS，向下取整到整秒。

questions.question_zh: 从第263小节开始的 meno vivo 段落出现了两次完整的“神秘和弦”。第一次奏响该和弦是在什么时间？
questions.question_en: The work features two complete spellings of the composer's so-called mystic chord in the 'meno vivo' passage starting at 263. At which time is the mystic chord struck for the first time?
questions.answer_instructions: 录音绝对时间 MM:SS，向下取整到整秒。

questions.question_zh: 第219—225小节的高声部旋律音中，哪一个音被演奏得最有力度？
questions.question_en: Which of the upper-voice melodic notes from bar 219 until 225 is played with the most force?
questions.answer_instructions: 音名及八度。

questions.question_zh: 录音11:17—11:28的段落，是先前哪个主题的变奏？请用该主题第一次出现时的速度／表情标记作答。
questions.question_en: The passage played at 11:17-11:28 is a variation of which theme played earlier in the piece? Answer with the tempo/expression marking associated with that theme, the first time it is played.
questions.answer_instructions: 谱面原有的完整速度／表情术语。

questions.question_zh: 录音07:57—08:41之间，演奏者在哪个小节之前松开踏板、且没有其他音持续，从而形成该区间最长的整体静默？
questions.question_en: Before what bar does the performer lift the pedal (without sustaining any other notes) for the longest time in the passage between 07:57 and 8:41? I.e., when does the longest global silence take place within that period?
questions.answer_instructions: 静默结束后进入的小节号，只写整数。

questions.question_zh: 本曲具有较长的引子，且第一主题由六小节乐句构成。呈示部从录音的什么时间开始？
questions.question_en: At what time does the exposition start, considering there is a long introduction and the first theme consists of 6-bar phrases.
questions.answer_instructions: 录音绝对时间 MM:SS，向下取整到整秒。

questions.question_zh: 10:20稍后到10:30之前，某个中声部出现超过五个音的下行完整半音阶。找出其中最长的连续半音阶线条，并给出起音与终音。
questions.question_en: A descending, fully chromatic line of more than 5 notes begins to sound in one of the middle voices, shortly after 10:20. On which notes does this line start and end? The line should contain all the notes in between the start and end note. Identify the longest possible line, before 10:30.
questions.answer_instructions: 两个音级，不写八度；先起音、后终音，以英文逗号分隔。

questions.question_zh: 作品结尾使用了先前引入过的一个音乐构思。这个构思最早是在录音的什么时间引入的？
questions.question_en: The piece ends with a musical idea that was introduced earlier. Starting at what time was this last musical idea first introduced?
questions.answer_instructions: 录音绝对时间 MM:SS，向下取整到整秒。
